tool.name: EQSANS eqsanscli (prototype)
tool.description: EQSANS data reduction TUI in your browser

param.name: ipts
param.label: IPTS number
param.help: eqsanscli starts in /SNS/EQSANS/IPTS-N/shared (your sessions there resume with /continue). Leave empty to start in your home folder.

tool.help:
**eqsanscli** — the EQSANS data-reduction terminal app, in your browser.
It is the same program you run on the analysis cluster, running as you, on an SNS node, in ``/SNS/EQSANS/IPTS-<N>/shared``. Sessions and reduced data are the same files you see from the cluster, so you can switch between the two freely.
- Closing the browser tab does **not** stop eqsanscli; reopen the tool's link to reconnect (a long reduction keeps running). - To end the session: quit eqsanscli (``^Q`` or ``/exit``), then press ``q``. Or stop the job in Galaxy. - ``/plot`` has no pop-up windows here — use ``/plot … --save file.png``.
